title: dryopteris phaeostigma
intro: Dryopteris phaeostigma, commonly known as Autumn fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is a type of vascular plant that is native to East Asia and is prized for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Autumn fern include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Autumn fern include anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, and anti-viral activities, and it is used in traditional medicine to treat a range of conditions, including respiratory infections and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Autumn fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
